raw:
(1) BAKED TEXT — Yes, there are rune characters (e.g., ᚠᚾᛞᚠ) etched into the gold chassis on either side of the main screen area. These are letters/words, violating the "ZERO baked text" rule.

(2) LAYOUT ADHERENCE — The layout is incorrect. A critical control, the `seek` slider (guide-colour=CHARTREUSE), is completely missing from the device. Additionally, the `vol` knob is not rendered, leaving only a large circular hole in its place. The remaining controls are in plausible positions.

(3) GUIDE-COLOUR RESIDUE — There is catastrophic guide-colour flooding. The `playpause` (MAGENTA), `prev` (PURE GREEN), `next` (ROSE PINK), `repeat` (SPRING GREEN), and `queue` (PURE RED) buttons are all rendered as solid blocks of their respective guide colours, not as properly painted controls. The `shuffle` slot is also a solid block of VIOLET-PURPLE.

(4) OVERALL QUALITY — POOR. While the metallic chassis of the shield is detailed and thematically strong, the skin is an absolute failure as a functional media player interface. The missing controls, placeholder hole for the knob, and the garish, unpainted, guide-coloured buttons completely undermine the quality and break the skeuomorphic illusion.

VERDICT: FAIL
